name: grip-keycaps
note: ADR-D01.74 on ADR-D01.75's grip: grip cap 150 by name and pin the key map over Local (Shift+/ outside sample mode). J, K and L carry the frame's twists with their cycles over the grip's marks, and the header names the grip. The next frame re-binds keys, which the map marks until it has been closed; shown again, it marks none.
